stamp: {"keys":[{"id":"k","problem":"A company's page lists its provident and study funds but not its index-tracking funds or money-market funds.","where":"the product choices at the top of the company page","kind":"general"}],"liked":[]}

raised: Page doesn't say which product or track is the reader's; it opened on the investment savings fund, which may not be theirs
Most tracks show only 'less than 3 years' with no track record
The 'from source / calculated / you entered' line is confusing because the reader entered nothing
The investment filter buttons are useless (almost all say 1), and terms like 'סחיר', 'עוקב מדדים - גמיש' and 'משולב' mean nothing
Extra direct expenses come out of the fund but aren't shown, so the reader doesn't know how much
The 'what Harel's documents say' sections are folded, so the reader didn't learn the small print and wants it opened up
Half the track names are jargon
The 'קופה' number column isn't explained (does it match the statement?)
The 'from deposits 0%' line is the same in every row and adds nothing
Doesn't understand 'מט"ח' (foreign currency), the coloured rings, or the dotted underlines
The '>' arrows don't show that they open something
Doesn't understand the difference between fees 'from savings' and 'from deposits', or which one they pay
'PF-10' in the note is unexplained
Returns are before fees and before tax, so it's unclear what the reader actually keeps
Can't see how Harel compares with other companies on this page
Wants returns after fees and tax, in shekels
No guidance on what's sensible at 61, near retirement
No information on the cost, tax or time of switching tracks or companies
Wants information on their pension and study fund, not just this investment fund
Doesn't know whether they can ask Harel for a lower fee
Would drop the folded index fund / severance fund / ETF sections
Would drop the 'didn't find a name?' search box

problems.why: The reader never says the company page is missing index-tracking or money-market funds; they only skipped the folded index fund and ETF sections as not theirs.
